profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | 6+ years professional experience
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with over 6 years of professional experience, building exceptional digital products and pleasing user experiences. Working primarily in JavaScript (React) and Python (Pyramid, Django), I like to build systems that solve everyday problems, achieve specific business goals, and create meaningful value for users.

A graduate of Flatiron School’s Full Stack Web Developer Program and VCU's School of Business, I consider myself to be a lifelong learner who is always working on a course, project, book, recipe or travel plan.

positions.title: Software Team Lead
positions.description:
Managed an engineering team in the Education product vertical: led 8 developers, guided technical execution and planning, prioritized project work in collaboration with the product team, provided feedback and mentorship through code reviews, and conducted developer performance evaluations.

Oversaw the delivery of 15 roadmap initiatives enhancing high-value, high-growth products—including Student Connect (React, Python, Django), Academic Insights (Next.js, Python, Pyramid), and Private Schools (React, Python, Pyramid).

Spearheaded a multi-phase workflow migration to improve the experience for B2B clients updating school content in Student Connect. Key components included building an authentication servlet for SSO, migrating thousands of content objects, and updating Django APIs and the React frontend to integrate seamlessly with the new architecture.

Led the development of the new K–12 Private Schools product, launching with school search, school data validation and ingestion, profile pages (including UGC), school-sponsored content, and CMS integration. Follow-up initiatives included post-MVP enhancements, data refinement, and a Sweepstakes feature to drive user reviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Architected and built a new application for exploring and comparing online courses and certificates using Python, React, and a custom ETL pipeline to normalize and present data from multiple third-party APIs and internal sources in an informative, searchable interface.

Invited to participate in the developer interview process, contributing to 16 rounds of technical screenings and panel debriefings during this period.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Delivered 40 features across 9 applications in the Education and News product verticals, resolved 148 bugs with an 86% first-pass QA success rate, and filed 68 tickets to guide implementation, propose refactoring improvements, and report production issues.

Developed the Admissions Calculator scatterplot feature, empowering users to compare test scores and admissions data. Generated 428,000 user interactions (leads) and drove 40,800 new user accounts between November 2020 and July 2023.

Implemented the redesign of the user reviews (UGC) feature in Best Colleges by building new React components, integrating a third-party reviews and moderation API, and developing three new pages for submitting and reading school reviews and FAQs, leading to the collection of over 6,000 college reviews between September 2019 and July 2023.

Contributed to site redesign and expansion by creating 18 pages across 4 products in a new React codebase, leveraging and extending an internal component system and CSS-in-JS.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer Student
positions.description: Graduate of Flatiron School's Full Stack Web Developer Program.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · HTML5 · Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) · React.js · JavaScript · React · Github · Ruby on Rails · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Entrepreneurship · jQuery · Redux

positions.title: Brand Strategist
positions.description:
Conducted consumer research and built consumer profiles—using syndicated research platforms—to prepare creative briefs and guide strategy recommendations for proposals and pitch decks.

Researched competitors and their marketing efforts to develop competitive analyses that informed strategic direction for new and existing clients.

Identified and evaluated potential consumer insight platforms for RedPeg’s strategy department to use on consumer research for current and future proposals.

positions.title: Brand Strategy Coordinator
positions.description:
Led primary research and data collection at the Square Enix Experience during San Diego Comic-Con 2016, resulting in 3,710 consumer emails and 487 survey responses being collected over two days.

Awarded RedPeg’s Growing Like a Weed Award in 2016—based upon peer voting throughout the company, this is awarded to the RedPeg employee who has made the most professional growth in the past year and continually exceeds the expectations of their peers.

positions.title: Associate Account Coordinator
positions.description:
Started as a summer intern in RedPeg Marketing's client services department in June 2015. During this time I helped coordinate and produce the Square Enix Experience at San Diego Comic-Con 2015, as well as a Verizon Destination Store grand opening in LA. After 2 months I was hired as a full-time employee in the client services department.

Managed on-site data collection for Square Enix and Verizon programs in 2015 which resulted in 2,833 entries of consumer information.

Served as the point of contact for all production and creative requests on an account team, after being hired full-time—ensuring accurate and timely communication of client needs to internal departments.

positions.title: Product Management / Business Development
positions.description: Grew into a part-time role at Mobelux during my senior year at VCU. I continued to test applications and participate in agile issue tracking for a number of their core clients. I also coordinated the initial stages of a small project called KickUp, which involved facilitating communication between the internal team and KickUp co-founders, building a project schedule with designers/developers, and scheduling meetings during the kickoff and branding stages of the project.

positions.title: Summer Marketing Internship
positions.description:
Started in 2014 as a part of the summer internship program and quickly created value by engaging in price quoting and B2B relationship building for an internal project called Starlite that was in its early stages.

Increasingly became more involved in their core business—designing and developing web/native applications—by feature testing digital products and helping with product management tasks.
